inputs: GALVANIC/Tarawa combat reports and surviving observations
loss of the atoll and US operational behavior
immediate_conclusions_8_11Feb: A stronger beach/lagoon defense can impose cost but cannot survive repeated battleship/carrier/direct-fire reduction on a shallow atoll without depth.
Distributed ammunition, local C2, shelters and alternate firing points materially improve survival and delay and therefore should be retained.
Massed exposed airfield aircraft and support functions are unacceptable; dispersion, decoys, rapid repair and withdrawal/staging routes remain mandatory.
Local counterattack and mobile reserve are more useful than a single early mass suicide attack, but open movement under US observation is extremely dangerous.
directive_11_15Feb_center: Beach positions become warning/delay/fire-control shells rather than the sole main battle line where terrain permits.
Main resistance should move deeper, reverse-slope, cave/tunnel or distributed strongpoint systems where geography allows.
Keep ammunition/water/C2 small and separated; provide alternate command posts, runners and redundant cable.
Pre-register inland blocking fires and anti-armor/anti-LVT lanes; hold small reserves under cover.
Preserve reconnaissance/water-air/sensor networks even when principal airfields are suppressed.

Eniwetok_short_warning_case.if_assault_within_10_14_days: Only field-expedient adaptation is possible: move/redisperse ammunition and water, designate local reserves, add alternate fighting positions, camouflage/decoys, relocate some command and crew shelters, re-register fires and abandon selected overly exposed beach positions. No deep cave/tunnel fortress can be created on a flat coral atoll in days.
Eniwetok_short_warning_case.guard: Do not back-port Palau/Marianas spring-summer depth-defense maturity into February Eniwetok.

longer_term_effect: Palau and Marianas receive weeks-to-months of additional time to convert the lesson into materially deeper, more redundant defenses; downstream fortification states must be reopened accordingly.
